tax.text: Smith supported tax cuts for families and legislation that defunded the IRS expansion and ended the IRS Direct File program.
tax.quote: we have successfully enacted major legislation this year to protect our borders, cut taxes for families

trade.text: Smith led a bipartisan group supporting the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement and described expanding market access for agricultural producers as a priority.
trade.quote: strenuously emphasizing our ongoing support for the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA)

immigration.text: Smith supported legislation providing $165 billion for border security, enforcement, detention, and completion of the southern border wall.
immigration.quote: In July, I supported the enactment of $165 billion for border security, enforcement, and detention, including completion of the southern border wall

health.text: Smith proposed legislation to expand Medicare patients’ access to testing and medication through community pharmacists.
health.quote: ECAPS would ensure those pharmacists can expand access for Medicare patients

voting.text: Smith cosponsored the SAVE America Act, which would require photo identification for voting, proof of citizenship for registration, and removal of noncitizens from voter rolls.
voting.quote: The SAVE America Act would require individuals to present an eligible photo ID before voting.

wages.text: She supports labor unions and says they help workers receive fair wages, safe working conditions, and representation.
wages.quote: Labor unions guarantee that hardworking Americans receive fair wages, safe and humane working conditions, and proper representation in business deliberations.

trade.text: She opposes the Trump administration’s tariffs and said the assistance provided to affected farmers is insufficient.
trade.quote: She’s against the current Trump administration’s increased tariffs, which Smith supported, and said the relief provided to the district’s farmers isn’t nearly enough.

debt.text: She criticized the One Big Beautiful Bill for raising the national debt and said government spending should be cut.
debt.quote: He supported the ‘One Big Beautiful Bill.’ That would raise the debt by several trillion dollars.

schools.text: She describes public education as essential to providing equal opportunity and preparing students for civic and working life.
schools.quote: Public education is a core feature of a prosperous and cohesive society.

safety.text: She says law-enforcement officers should receive the support, training, and resources needed to keep communities safe.
safety.quote: Acknowledging their sacrifices and equipping them with the necessary support, training, and resources is vital to keeping our communities safe.

immigration.text: She supports securing the border while also describing the United States as a place of hope for immigrants.
immigration.quote: Yet, while we reinforce these boundaries, we must remember that our nation has been, and always will be, a beacon of hope for all.

guns.text: She supports the Second Amendment for law-abiding citizens while also calling for an equally strong effort to prevent violence.
guns.quote: Our commitment to the Second Amendment should be paralleled by an equally strong commitment to prevent violence and safeguard our communities.

abortion.text: She strongly supports a woman’s right to make private reproductive-health decisions with her doctor.
abortion.quote: I strongly support a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions privately with her own doctor.

health.text: She says she would advocate for improved health care for all and identifies lack of insurance and coverage restrictions as barriers to care.
health.quote: I will advocate for improved health care for all Americans.

wages.text: Budke supports workers’ freedom to organize and collectively bargain while also respecting Nebraska’s right-to-work law.
wages.quote: She believes workers should have the freedom to organize and collectively bargain if they choose

schools.text: Budke supports strengthening rural schools, improving teacher retention, and investing in education programs within local communities.
schools.quote: She supports practical education policies that strengthen rural schools

immigration.text: Budke supports both immigration-law enforcement and reforms that make the legal process faster, more transparent, and protective of due process.
immigration.quote: Macey supports practical reforms that strengthen both fairness and enforcement

guns.text: Budke supports enforcing background checks and narrowly tailored interventions when credible threats exist, while opposing broad federal bans.
guns.quote: Macey supports responsible gun ownership alongside policies that strengthen background check enforcement

health.text: Budke opposes reductions in federal Medicaid funding because rural hospitals rely on those funds to remain open.
health.quote: My concern is the yearly reduction in Medicaid funding from the federal government. Rural hospitals rely on those dollars to remain operational.

energy.text: Supports domestic energy production, biofuels, innovation, and grid reliability while opposing rigid one-size-fits-all energy mandates.
energy.quote: Macey supports responsible domestic production alongside practical investment in innovation that improves efficiency, expands biofuel markets, strengthens grid reliability, and supports agricultural resilience.

tax.text: Cohen says tax revenue should support rural health care and other services and that taxes on the wealthy should rise.
tax.quote: We need to have a serious discussion about raising taxes on the super wealthy.

trade.text: Cohen opposes the current tariffs, saying they raise agricultural input costs and reduce demand for Nebraska farm products.
trade.quote: This administration’s ill-conceived tariffs are hurting farmers, ranchers, and related industries.

debt.text: Cohen says wealthy people should pay more so the country can balance its budget rather than add trillions of dollars to the debt.
debt.quote: policies that make the billionaires pay their fair share so we can balance our budget once and for all—not saddle our children with trillions in debt.

schools.text: Cohen supports using public funds for public education rather than private schools.
schools.quote: having public funds be used for public education and not private schools.

immigration.text: Cohen opposes the current one-size-fits-all immigration policy, proposes reducing ICE funding, and supports a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: clarify a path to citizenship for those undocumented in the country.

guns.text: Cohen says he left the Democratic Party partly because of its approach to gun control and describes himself as supporting responsible gun rights.
guns.quote: he disagreed with the party position on guns

health.text: Cohen says Congress should prioritize rural health care, protect Medicaid funding, and support rural hospitals through public revenue.
health.quote: Cuts to Medicaid directly impact rural hospitals.

energy.text: Cohen says climate change is harming Nebraska and supports investing in a transition toward cleaner energy while using fossil fuels as a bridge.
energy.quote: We need leaders who will invest in that transition honestly rather than pretending there's no river to cross.

sources: adriansmith.house.gov · beckystille2026.com · nebraskapublicmedia.org · budkeforcongress.com · markfornebraska.org · yahoo.com · centralnebraskatoday.com
